messages:
anya: heads-up, noticed a pattern this morning where small pods stay in Pending with Preempting=true for minutes and then get evicted in bursts.

matt: timeline? which AZs?

anya: eu-west1-c mainly. saw 50+ pods in kube-scheduler queue, backpressure on alloc loop. thread root ts 6187654321

leo: hmm, we saw a similar spike last month but with warmpool refill. Did you grab scheduler metrics? /metrics shows preempt_coalescer_queue_len spike.

anya: yes, attaching logs snippet:

```text
I0320 08:12:01 scheduler.go:123] preempt_coalescer enqueue 12 pods, reason: nic_throttle
I0320 08:12:02 scheduler.go:130] coalescer flush after 30s, allocated 4 pods
I0320 08:12:33 scheduler.go:142] leak detected: queue_len 28, last_flush 120s ago
```

priya: can you run `kubectl get pods -n ml -o wide --field-selector=status.phase=Pending` and paste output?

anya: pasted: (short list) ml-train-24 Pending nodeSelector=gpu:true preempting=true -> AGE 6m

sam: what's the admission/provisioning path? Are we hitting provider rate limits for creating nodes in eu-west1c?

anya: checked cloud metrics: provider create rate OK, but autoscaler logs show throttled backoff due to api rate-limit bursts during the flush.

matt: so autoscaler + scheduler coalescer timing interacting badly -> prolonged pending -> eviction cascade. Any temporary mitigations?

leo: can we shorten coalescer window? current 30s to 5s for small-pod path. Also set autoscaler burstable=true to accept faster node adds.

anya: repro patch I tested sets env SCHED_COALESCE_MS=5000 and observed queue flushes more often, fewer evicts.

priya: risks? more frequent small allocs could increase fragmentation.

sam: tradeoff seems better than evict storms. maybe enable only for small-gang label: pod.k8s.redwood/gang-size<=4

scheduler-bot: rollouts/1234 started by matt: feature-flag preempt-coalescer-short-window -> 10% canary

matt: i'll open a follow-up RFC and request canary today. @priya @leo please watch pod churn + fragmentation heatmap.

anya: thanks — will attach Grafana panels for queue_len, eviction_rate, node_create_rate.

leo: thumbs up. if canary shows improvement we can keep burstable autoscaler tweak and revert if fragmentation rises.

sam: sg. creating pager runbook update for this class.

matt: closing for now, continue observations. :thumbsup:
